description: This file defines the MapStatus trait and its implementations (CompressedMapStatus and HighlyCompressedMapStatus) used in Apache Spark to track the status and sizes of map output blocks during shuffle operations. It includes methods for serialization, size compression, and handling large or sparse blocks.

classes.name: CompressedMapStatus
classes.description: A MapStatus implementation that tracks the size of each block using compressed byte representations.

classes.name: HighlyCompressedMapStatus
classes.description: A MapStatus implementation that handles large or sparse blocks with accurate size tracking and bitmaps.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Factory method to create either HighlyCompressedMapStatus or CompressedMapStatus based on the number of partitions.

methods.name: compressSize
methods.description: Compresss a size in bytes into a byte using logarithmic encoding for efficient reporting.

methods.name: decompressSize
methods.description: Decompresss an 8-bit encoded size back to a long value.
